controls.name: base
controls.description: Historical base: every navigation path passes bare hosts through.

controls.name: tool-handlers-only
controls.description: Normalizes the agents' goto tools but not the server's first navigation or the CDP base action.

controls.name: skip-cua-parser
controls.description: Misses the parser-based agent's goto action.

controls.name: separator-heuristic
controls.description: Treats any URL without '://' as scheme-less, which breaks about:blank and data: URLs.

controls.name: no-trim
controls.description: Prefixes the scheme without trimming surrounding whitespace.

controls.name: urlsplit-allowlist
controls.description: Legitimate alternative helper: urlsplit plus an allowlist of real schemes.

controls.name: normalize-at-route
controls.description: Legitimate alternative: the server normalizes the start URL at its user-message route instead of in the loop.

mutations.urlsplit-allowlist:
--- reference/src/agi_agents/shared/url_utils.py
+++ urlsplit-allowlist/src/agi_agents/shared/url_utils.py
@@ -1,34 +1,18 @@
 """URL helpers shared across agent navigation handlers."""
 
-import re
+from urllib.parse import urlsplit
 
-# Matches a leading ``scheme://`` (http, https, file, chrome, chrome-extension, ...).
-_SCHEME_RE = re.compile(r"^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9+.\-]*://")
-
-# Schemes that are valid without an ``//`` authority separator.
-_SCHEMELESS_SCHEME_RE = re.compile(
-    r"^(about|data|javascript|blob|mailto|tel|view-source):",
-    re.IGNORECASE,
-)
+_KNOWN_SCHEMES = {
+    "http", "https", "file", "about", "data", "chrome", "chrome-extension", "blob",
+    "view-source", "javascript", "mailto", "tel", "ws", "wss", "ftp",
+}
 
 
 def normalize_url(url: str) -> str:
-    """Prepend ``https://`` to a scheme-less URL before browser navigation.
-
-    Browser engines (patchright/Playwright) raise "Cannot navigate to invalid
-    URL" when handed a bare domain such as ``example.com``. Normalizing here
-    means the agent no longer has to notice the error, prepend a scheme, and
-    retry, saving a wasted step on the first navigation.
-
-    Already-schemed URLs are returned unchanged, including ``http://``,
-    ``https://``, ``file://``, ``chrome://``, ``chrome-extension://`` and the
-    authority-less schemes ``about:``, ``data:``, ``blob:``, ``view-source:``
-    and ``javascript:``. Scheme-less inputs (bare domains, ``localhost``,
-    ``localhost:3000`` and ``IP:port``) get ``https://``.
-    """
+    """Default scheme-less navigation targets to https."""
     stripped = url.strip()
     if not stripped:
         return url
-    if _SCHEME_RE.match(stripped) or _SCHEMELESS_SCHEME_RE.match(stripped):
+    if urlsplit(stripped).scheme.lower() in _KNOWN_SCHEMES:
         return stripped
-    return f"https://{stripped}"
+    return "https://" + stripped
